pump1.basis: User-reported collection: 4.1 mL in 5 s; corrected total 8.2 mL in 10 s

pump2.basis: Assumed equal to Pump 1 at user direction; not separately measured

pump3.basis: Assumed equal to Pump 1 at user direction; not separately measured

control_use: Reservoir volume corrected by user from 12.5 L to 18 L. Provisional pulse and cumulative caps are the prior 20 L proposal multiplied by 18/20 to retain the same mL-per-liter upper bounds. Pump 2 and 3 flow use the user-approved shared-model estimate of 0.82 mL/s. The 2 L sequential chemical test is not a dose-response calibration for the 18 L operating reservoir. These limits do not predict a final pH or EC.
